en: The postcard depicts a historic black-and-white image of a large public square with market stalls, surrounded by ornate European-style buildings. The text 'STORA TORGET, SUNDSVALL.' indicates the scene is in Sundsvall, Sweden. There is a handwritten message along the margins in Swedish. The reverse side has Swedish text printed and handwritten, as well as a green Swedish stamp postmarked with the word 'Sundsvall.'
